name: ui-dialog
description: Bootstrap dialog on the native <dialog>: modal or not, static backdrop, sizes, fullscreen, scrollable, animations, swapping, triggers.

descriptions.--bs-dialog-transition-property: Properties animated on open and close.
descriptions.--bs-dialog-backdrop-blur: Blur of the page behind the backdrop.
descriptions.--bs-dialog-header-border-color: Colour of the line under the header.
descriptions.--bs-dialog-header-border-width: Width of the line under the header.
descriptions.--bs-dialog-footer-border-color: Colour of the line above the footer.
descriptions.--bs-dialog-footer-border-width: Width of the line above the footer.
